1. पच् or पञ्च् cl. 1. P. Ā. पचति, ˚ते, or पञ्चति, ˚ते, to spread out, make clear or evident, Dhātup. vi, 14 :
Caus. -पञ्चयति, xxxii, 108 See प्र-पञ्चय.

etym.s: [cf. Gk. πέσσω for πεκ-ϳω; Lat. coquo; Slav. peką, pešti.]

spans.s: 3. पच् mfn. (ifc.; nom. -पक्, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 15, Sch.) cooking, baking.
1. पच mfn. id. (cf. अल्पम्-, इष्टि-, किम्- &c.)
f. the act of cooking &c., L.
पाचा, ˚चि or ˚चिका, f. cooking, maturing, L.
पच—पच m. ‘continually bringing to maturity’ (?) N. of Śiva, MBh.
पच—म्-पचा f. Curcuma Aromatica or Xanthorrhiza, Bhpr. (v.l. -बचा, L.)
पच—प्रकूटा and पच—लवणा, f. g. मयूर-व्यंसकादि.
पच—प्रकूटा and पच—लवणा, f. g. मयूर-व्यंसकादि.
mf(इका)n. cooking, roasting, baking, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a cook, Gṛhyās., (f(इका). a female cook; see below)
1. पचत॑ mfn. cooked, boiled &c., RV.; VS.; ŚāṅkhBr.
पचत—भृज्जता f. (2. pl. Impv. of √ पच् and √ भृज्ज्) continual baking and roasting g. मयूर-व्यंसकादि.
पचत्य᳙ mfn. cooked, dressed, RV. iii, 52, 2.
(प॑च्˚), n. a means or instrument for cooking, RV.; ŚBr.
cooking, roasting, maturing, becoming cooked or ripe, MBh.; Suśr.; BhP.
mf(ई)n. causing to cook or boil, softening, digestive, Suśr.
the act of cooking or baking &c.
causing a wound to close, a styptic for closing wounds, Suśr.
extracting extraneous substances from a wound &c. by means of cataplasms, a cataplasm, ib.
any medicinal preparation or decoction, W.
the wild citron tree, L. (v.l. पवनी)
or पच्चनी f. a partic. part of a plough, Kṛṣis.
पचन—क्रिया f. cooking, dressing food, Gaut.
or पच्चनी f. a partic. part of a plough, Kṛṣis.
accustomed to cook one's food, Baudh.
पाचा, ˚चि or ˚चिका, f. cooking, maturing, L.
पा˚ची f. a species of plant
being soon cooked, cooking or ripening quickly, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 96,
Phaseolus Mungo or a similar species of bean
capable of being cooked or matured, ŚvetUp.
पच्—छब्द (for शब्द) m. the noise of feet or footsteps, L.
पच्—छस् ind. (for शस्) foot by foot, Pāda by Pāda, Br.; PārGṛ.; ChUp.
पच्—छः-शस्य n. the recitation by Pādas, Vait.
पच्—छौच (for शौच) n. cleansing or purifying to feet, ĀśvGṛ.
पाचक—स्त्री f. a female cook, Vop.
having a cook for a wife, Pāṇ. vi, 3, 37, Sch.
पा˚चनक n. a dissolvent, digestive, Car.
causing a wound to close (by means of styptics &c.), ib.,
पा˚चनीय mfn. to be cooked or digested
= राधन-द्रव्य, n. dissolving or a dissolvent.
